tools.name: draft_quote
tools.description: Use this when a contractor describes a job (what they saw on site, what needs doing, quantities) and wants an itemized quote. Builds the draft only from the contractor's own price book; lines with no match are flagged and left unpriced, never guessed. Side effects: saves a new draft quote in the con

tools.name: open_quotes
tools.description: Show the contractor's 10 most recent FieldDraft quotes with title, client, status, total and a link to each. Read-only; changes nothing.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Fetch one of the contractor's FieldDraft quotes by its id (from draft_quote or list_quotes), with line items, options and totals. Read-only; changes nothing.

tools.name: list_quotes
tools.description: List the contractor's recent FieldDraft quotes, newest first, with title, status, total and id (default 10, up to 50). Read-only; changes nothing.

tools.name: update_quote_lines
tools.description: Replace ALL line items on a draft quote with the supplied list, after the contractor asks for changes (quantities, prices, adding or removing lines). tools.name: push_quote_to_jobber
tools.description: Create the quote in the contractor's connected Jobber account, as a draft they review and send from Jobber. Only call after the contractor explicitly confirms the draft. Requires a client name; ask for it (plus email and job site address if known) when missing. Side effects: creates a new quote in J

tools.name: sync_price_book
tools.description: Re-import the contractor's products & services from their connected Jobber account so drafts use current prices. tools.name: search_price_book
tools.description: Find items in the contractor's own price book by name or description, to answer 'what do I charge for X' or to fix an unmatched line. Returns up to 25 items. Read-only; changes nothing.
